population.selection_note: Reference-selected exact-three-nonempty-newline-terminated physical-line population; V2-Hard is an oracle structural diagnostic.

tokenizer.newline_token_definition: All tokenizer IDs whose single-token decode contains newline or carriage return.

common_generation.attention: Every real prefix, generation, future-mask, locked-separator, and suffix token attends in the full forward; only right PAD is excluded.
common_generation.selection: After full forward, select only eligible unresolved generation positions; choose one position with largest negative entropy confidence.
common_generation.mask_noop: An official-compatible mask-token proposal consumes a forward and remains unresolved; it is counted explicitly.
common_generation.canvas_length_accounting: Generation-region tokens, masks, and locked newline tokens only; prefix, suffix, and right PAD excluded.

v2_hard.label: oracle exact-three-line structural diagnostic
v2_hard.newline_policy: All generated hard-slot tokens containing newline or carriage return are forbidden at vocabulary-logit level.
v2_hard.completion: Direct token extraction of three hard slots and three locked newline separators; no string truncation or repair.

v2_opentail.label: primary progressive version
v2_opentail.newline_policy: Hard slots forbid every newline-containing token; OPEN_TAIL permits them.
v2_opentail.completion: Direct token extraction of slot 0, locked newline, slot 1, locked newline, and tail; no trailing locked newline and no repair.

joint_opentail.label: matched-canvas joint-denoising mechanism control
joint_opentail.activation: HARD_SLOT_0, HARD_SLOT_1, and OPEN_TAIL are jointly eligible from the first forward.
joint_opentail.newline_policy: Selected hard-slot logits forbid every newline-containing token; selected OPEN_TAIL logits permit them.

expand_delete.normal: Replace only the selected mask; preserve region ID.
expand_delete.expand: Replace only the selected mask with two masks inheriting its region ID; recompute all masks and positions after mutation.
expand_delete.expand_caps: Forbid expand at vocabulary-logit level when a selected hard slot has length 32, global middle has length 64, or real context would exceed 2048.
expand_delete.delete: An EOS proposal deletes only the selected unresolved generation position; shift synchronized arrays left and right-pad one PAD.

full.selection: all frozen-manifest rows in frozen order

evaluator.execution_note: The preserved local evaluator checkout differs from upstream only by enabling the documented exec(check_program, exec_globals) line used by the historical V1 scoring.
evaluator.compile_metric: ast.parse plus compile over prompt + completion + suffix

baseline_reuse.timing_status: mixed CPU/GPU historical timing; excluded from pure-H200 compute comparison
